boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Linfield University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe McMinnville destinations with directly verified evening, midnight, or overnight access, including two Linfield campus stops and practical food or supply runs.

cards.title: Take the Midnight Study Run
cards.subtitle: Linfield’s McMinnville campus library
cards.notes: Bring your Linfield ID and settle in before midnight; academic-term access ends earlier on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: A campus study destination open until midnight four weeknights and Sunday during academic terms.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield lists student, faculty and staff hours of 7:30 a.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday and noon–midnight Sunday during academic terms.
cards.access_notes: Academic-term hours for students, faculty and staff are until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday; summer and break hours end at 4:30 p.m. weekdays.

cards.title: Catch Subhub’s Evening Window
cards.subtitle: Late campus dining at Linfield University
cards.notes: Check the posted weekly schedule first, then arrive during the short evening service window before its 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining counter scheduled specifically for evening service rather than daytime meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield Dining’s current hours page lists Subhub service until 11 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday for the displayed regular schedule.
cards.access_notes: The displayed schedule lists 7:30–11 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and 7–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; verify the selected week before leaving.

cards.title: Use the Around-the-Clock Counter
cards.subtitle: 220 NE 12th Street in McMinnville
cards.notes: Head to the 12th Street location when other kitchens have closed; the official locator identifies continuous daily service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Mexican-food stop north of Linfield’s campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The company’s official locations page identifies its McMinnville restaurant at 220 NE 12th Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours every day according to the official location listing.

cards.title: Aim for the Late Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 915 NE Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and confirm whether the 2 or 3 a.m. closing time applies that night.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 99W drive-thru operating several hours past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at this McMinnville location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in McMinnville, OR – 915 NE Highway 99W
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: Save This for the Latest Drive
cards.subtitle: 2565 NE Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru service after 10 p.m.; the lobby closes well before the overnight ordering window ends.
cards.short_summary: An overnight drive-thru with especially long Thursday-through-Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, until 4 a.m. Thursday, and continuously from 4 a.m. Friday through 4 a.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru operates until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, until 4 a.m. Thursday, and 24 hours Friday and Saturday; lobby closes at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Make the One A.M. Food Run
cards.subtitle: 1730 N Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Go before 1 a.m. and use either the restaurant or drive-thru; both carry the same official daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A nightly fast-food option with consistent 1 a.m. hours all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed as open until 1 a.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Order Before the One A.M. Cutoff
cards.subtitle: 635 NE Highway 99W, Suite B
cards.notes: Check the live store page before ordering; it displays that day’s closing time alongside carryout and delivery options.
cards.short_summary: A McMinnville pizza counter whose official store page documents service until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official McMinnville store page identifies the restaurant at 635 NE Highway 99W, Suite B, and displays a current closing time of 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently displays service until 1 a.m.; consult its live status because daily hours can vary.

cards.title: Use the Eleven P.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 1691 N Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru after 10 p.m.; the lobby closes an hour earlier than vehicle service every night.
cards.short_summary: A predictable late-evening drive-thru with daily 11 p.m. closing hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists drive-thru hours until 11 p.m. daily at 1691 N Highway 99W, while restaurant and lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 11 p.m. daily; restaurant and lobby close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Restock Groceries Until Eleven
cards.subtitle: 2490 N Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Use the main store for a late grocery run, but do not assume the pharmacy or staffed departments share its closing time.
cards.short_summary: A grocery and household-supply stop open through 11 p.m. every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Safeway’s official local page lists the McMinnville store at 2490 N Highway 99W as open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Safeway Grocery – N Hwy 99 W, McMinnville
cards.access_notes: Main store hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Sunday; pharmacy and department hours are shorter.

cards.title: Make the Last Supply Run
cards.subtitle: 2375 NE Highway 99W in McMinnville
cards.notes: Arrive before 11 p.m. for groceries or basic supplies, and verify separate service-counter hours if you need specialized help.
cards.short_summary: A broad late-evening supply stop with the same closing time seven days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart’s official Store #1843 page lists the McMinnville location at 2375 NE Highway 99W as open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The main store is open until 11 p.m. Monday–Sunday; pharmacy and other service hours differ.
